numbers.evidence: EON is Phonak’s 3rd generation of real-time AI

numbers.condition: less power than the generation before it
numbers.evidence: runs two artificial intelligence systems in parallel while drawing 37% less power than the generation before it.
The first of the two systems, Spheric Speech Clarity 3.0, uses a deep neural network
The second, AutoSense OS AI 8.0, classifies the surrounding sound environment

numbers.condition: smaller than the previous Sphere generation
numbers.evidence: EON is 25% smaller and 20% lighter than the previous Sphere generation

numbers.condition: lighter than the previous Sphere generation

can improve the signal-to-noise ratio by as much as 30 dB
